explanation: It is 0 at every D1 and D2 step, and at GO it is 0 unless the agent is on a losing streak late in the episode (around trial 60 or later): at the GO of the second unrewarded trial in a row it is about 1 to 4, and at the third or so in a row it peaks at about 8 to 10, usually on the trial where the agent switches to the other action. It falls back to 0 (or about 4) on the next trial even if rewards are still missing, stays 0 after any rewarded trial, and is near 0 early in the episode.
